Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium, finished 2D cartoon mobile tower-defense game screen for the original Peruvian Andean game Guardianes de la Chacra. Single edge-to-edge landscape 20:9 screen, target 2400x1080. No device frame, no surrounding presentation, no watermark. Inspired by the expressive, readable, playful visual quality of Plants vs. Zombies 2, with entirely original Andean characters and UI. Warm golden maize yellow, leaf green, turquoise, terracotta, plum accents; cream UI surfaces, soft chunky dark-brown outlines, restrained painterly shading and tactile beveled buttons. High quality stylized 2D illustration, not realistic, not 3D. Rounded bold highly readable Spanish typography, generous touch targets and safe margins. UI panels only subtly decorated with Andean woven geometric details, never visually noisy. Corn kernels are the only currency, potatoes in the collca are lives, stars indicate level completion. Do not add gems, shop, energy, purchases, quest systems or other unsupported mechanics. No zombies or copied PvZ characters. This is a coherent art direction for a 15-screen reference collection.
SCREEN 01 MAIN MENU. Input image is a reference for existing content and functions only; completely redesign its basic visual presentation. Beautiful sunny Andean valley, distant softly painted snowy peaks, terraced fields and a small stone collca storing potatoes. Composition leaves a clean central area for UI. Top center a beautifully lettered original game logo reading exactly 'GUARDIANES DE LA CHACRA', on a carved ochre/wood and green-leaf sign with a very subtle woven trim. Below it the exact subtitle '¡Defiende la cosecha de la collca!'. Center lower-middle one prominent bright maize-gold large button with play icon and label 'Jugar'. Directly below two smaller cream buttons with illustrated book and gear icons labeled 'Bestiario' and 'Ajustes'. On the left edge a lovable confident small Andean Hondero farmer with sling, terracotta poncho, turquoise sash and wool chullo; on the right edge a cute white llama with turquoise woven blanket. Both frame the central UI without overlapping it. Small mischievous brown weevil enemies peeking through foreground crop leaves. Legible full-screen game interface, beautiful restrained composition, production-quality game concept art.
